svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut 12 mm plywood to 1,010 x 535 mm, square.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Round the corners about 5 mm and sand the edges.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill eight 4.5 mm holes, countersunk for an 8 mm head: four along

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: each long edge, 22.5 mm in from the edge, at 105, 375, 635 and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: rests on the top faces of the two low rails, flush with their

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: outside faces, 5 mm clear of the legs at each end. It is slid in

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: from the front, above the front low rail, then lowered and held

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: down by eight 4 x 30 mm countersunk wood screws into the rails.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: It carries the two ballast slabs, side by side, 40 mm apart.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: it lies flat on both rails and does not touch a leg.
